pages: Day 106: The days have passed in a blink. The ordinariness of this village and its daily routine were a blessing for my tired bones. For Him it is the opposite. Each day that passes makes Him more tense and quick-tempered. I think it is time to move on soon.

Day 107: One of the villagers got sick this morning and his condition worsened with each minute. His skin was covered in purulent rashes and his eyes started bleeding. He died within hours. We will stay for the funeral. May he find peace.
